name: Wontons
assumptions: Recipe makes approximately 50-60 wontons based on 1 packet of wrappers; typical serving is 12-15 pieces per person yielding 4 main-dish servings
Preparation and frying time conservatively estimated at 30 minutes total
Wonton skins assumed to contain wheat flour (standard)
Soy sauce assumed to contain soy and wheat (standard)
Sesame seed oil treated as containing sesame
No explicit egg, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, or peanuts; ambiguous for some sauces but classified conservatively
Water and frying oil classified as neutral for diets and allergens
All classifications based strictly on listed ingredients without assuming unlisted compounds
instructions:
Combine pork, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, and vegetables in a bowl.
Separate wonton skins.
Place a heaping teaspoon of filling in the center of the wonton.
Brush water on 2 borders of the skin, covering 1/4 inch from the edge.
Fold skin over to form a triangle, sealing edges.
Pinch the two long outside points together.
Heat oil to 450 degrees and fry 4 to 5 at a time until golden.
Drain and serve with sauce.

ingredients.name: Pork
ingredients.assumptions: Standard raw ground pork; 1 lb = 453.6 g edible portion.

ingredients.name: Garlic Clove
ingredients.assumptions: 3 average garlic cloves chopped, total ~9 g edible weight.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp grated fresh ginger root ~2 g edible.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: 3 medium carrots finely chopped, total edible ~150 g after peeling.

ingredients.name: Celery
ingredients.assumptions: 3 medium celery stalks finely chopped, total edible ~120 g after trimming.

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 6 medium spring onions (scallions) chopped, total edible ~90 g.

ingredients.name: Wonton Skin
ingredients.assumptions: Standard 1 packet (about 50-60 skins) of wonton wrappers, total ~230 g edible.

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Oil for deep frying (assumed 25 g absorbed per typical batch of 4-5 wontons based on recipe context and common frying estimates; not the full fryer volume).

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.assumptions: Water for sealing (assumed ~30 g brushed on from a bottle; negligible nutrition).
